title: orch push via send-keys lands in composer but does not submit; report loss is recurring
description: Worker and sidecar completion reports are pushed to the orchestrator pane as a one-line send-keys message (the CAM-55 push model, text plus Enter atomic in one call). Recurring failure observed by the operator (multiple times, latest 2026-07-06): the pushed line lands in the orchestrator TUI composer but the Enter does not submit, so the message sits unsent and the orchestrator never receives the report. Concrete instance: the ship-phase gates-failed report for CAM-118 (14:26 UTC) sat un-submitted in the composer; the orchestrator only learned of the failure when the operator mentioned it, then had to reconstruct the outcome from cam-worker-events.jsonl. Atomic text+Enter (CAM-55) is necessary but evidently not sufficient: the likely mechanism is a composer race when the TUI is busy (streaming, rendering, or mid-turn) when the keys arrive, with the trailing Enter consumed as a newline or dropped. Fix direction, in line with the structured-handback decision (CAM-75/77/78: pane push is only a wake-up, durable truth lives in files): (a) delivery verification in the single pusher (sidecar): after send-keys, verify submission (e.g. capture-pane shows the line left the composer, or pane state check) and retry with bounded backoff; (b) treat unverifiable delivery as a wedge signal: emit an event (push-undelivered) so the flight recorder shows it; (c) since the durable truth already exists (worker-report.json, cam-worker-events.jsonl, ship-phase-result events), the orchestrator side needs only the wake-up to be reliable, no content needs to travel in the pane line. Do NOT parse pane scrollback as the fix (rendered markdown is lossy, the known capture-pane trap). Cross-refs: CAM-195 (evented terminals the orch can derive on wake), CAM-55 (atomic send-keys decision), CAM-167 (worker pane lifecycle).

acceptanceCriteria: A shared helper sendKeysVerified is extracted: it idle-gates before send (reusing the isOrchPaneIdle check from dispatch.ts), sends the atomic text+Enter in one send-keys call WITHOUT -l (preserving the CAM-55 literal-Enter gotcha), then verifies post-send that the composer emptied (the pushed line left the composer) and retries with bounded backoff (reusing computeBackoffMs, loop.ts:576-587) up to N=3.

The sidecar report pusher makeNotifyOrchestrator (host.ts:198-209) uses sendKeysVerified instead of the current fire-and-forget spawn; the factory and its three sidecar call-sites (sidecar.ts:607,982,1843) are threaded with the capturePane reader and logEvent deps the verifier needs (the signature is currently (sessionName, spawnFn) only).

The thin-proxy injector sendKeysWhenIdle (dispatch.ts:156-204) also uses sendKeysVerified, so cam issue / cam review / cam ship injections AND the meta-loop dispatch injection get the same verify+retry; the existing pre-send idle-gate behavior is preserved, not regressed.

Delivery verification is a composer-emptied pane-STATE check (did the line leave the composer), never a parse of rendered pane scrollback for content: the durable truth never travels in the pane line, only the wake-up does (per CAM-75/77/78; the capture-pane rendered-markdown trap is not used as the fix).

A new event kind push-undelivered is emitted only on retry exhaustion, so the flight recorder (cam-worker-events.jsonl) records a lost wake-up. No new durable marker is added: terminals that matter already write their own durable markers (CAM-195 blocked, ship-stalled, CAM-174 post-merge-stalled) which the orchestrator surfaces at next boot, and a lost non-terminal narration is self-healing (the sidecar proceeds regardless).
spec.scope: Fix the recurring report-loss where a pushed one-line send-keys report lands in the orchestrator TUI composer but the trailing Enter does not submit (composer race when the TUI is busy streaming/rendering/mid-turn), so the orchestrator never receives the wake-up. Atomic text+Enter (CAM-55) is necessary but insufficient. Fix at the class level: extract a shared sendKeysVerified (idle-gate + atomic send + composer-emptied verify + bounded retry) and use it in BOTH pushers - the sidecar report pusher (makeNotifyOrchestrator, the autonomous silent one the issue names) and the thin-proxy injector (sendKeysWhenIdle, which also drives meta-loop dispatch injection). Emit push-undelivered on retry exhaustion for observability. The pane push remains only a wake-up; durable truth already lives in files (worker-report.json, cam-worker-events.jsonl) and terminal markers. Touches ~5-7 source files: host.ts, worker-report.ts (argv unchanged), dispatch.ts, session.ts (pane resolution reuse), events.ts (new kind), sidecar.ts (call-site wiring), loop.ts (narrate seam).
gotchas: makeNotifyOrchestrator currently takes only (sessionName, spawnFn) and is fire-and-forget with stdio ignore; adding verification requires threading a capturePane reader and logEvent into the factory and its three sidecar call-sites (sidecar.ts:607,982,1843, plus host.ts:763).

Do NOT regress: the CAM-55 atomic text+Enter WITHOUT -l (a literal Enter becomes text, never submits); the thin-proxy's existing pre-send idle-gate; orch pane resolution via getOrchPaneId (pane index 0, semicolon separator not tab - the format-tab-mangle lesson) and liveness via @cam_label=='orchestrator' (not pane_current_command, the bash-respawn-wrapper lesson).

Delivery verification must be a composer-state check only (emptied vs still-holding-the-line); parsing rendered pane scrollback for report content is explicitly banned (lossy rendered-markdown trap). The truth stays in files; the pane carries only the wake-up.

Independent of CAM-195 (co-located at the same terminal seam where narrateReport fires adjacent to emit calls, but the durable files CAM-200 relies on predate CAM-195); not blockedBy, can land in any order.
The git-origin push verification event already named pushed (events.ts:102, PushEventDetail) is unrelated to send-keys delivery; do not overload it - push-undelivered is a distinct kind.
